newsitem.title: UK: Lloyd's says surplus payments to Names on target.
newsitem.headline: Lloyd's says surplus payments to Names on target.

text.p: Lloyd's of London said on Friday that the payment of surpluses to its members, known as "Names", was proceeding according to plan.
"Things are proceeding according to the timetable we established in the first place," Lloyd's chief executive Ron Sandler told a news briefing.

Sandler said he was making the update in order to correct "a certain amount of misinformation and misunderstanding on what has been happening". The payments were due to be made within "about three months" of its recent recovery plan.
